name: CP2K
description: Builds CP2K 2026.2 (cp2k.psmp) into /opt/wise with the image's MPI, FFTW, ScaLAPACK and OpenBLAS; libxc, libint, libxsmm and DBCSR come from CP2K's own checksum-verified toolchain. With gpuVersion it builds the CUDA version against the CUDA base image.

gpuVersion.description: CP2K GPU target; requires the CUDA base image. Empty builds the CPU version.
